{{Quote|Obviously, to the Empire, we are criminals and a threat to their domination. But to the citizens, we Rebels may be viewed as Freedom Fighters...or as the criminals that the Empire is making us to be.|Acun Solari, to a Rebel operative|<ref name="SWG:E" />}}
'''Acun Solari''' was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|The more the actual pirates and criminal elements terrorize citizens while we do nothing to help them, the more we are lumped in with their ilk.|Acun Solari, to a Rebel operative|<ref name="SWG:E" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Acun Solari was based in the city of [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]], on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SWG:E" />

[[File:Crashed_escape_pod_SWG.jpg|250px|thumb|left|The corpse of the Rebel pilot near his crashed escape pod]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a starship of the Alliance was attacked in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. Fortunately, the [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]], a friend of Acun Solari, fled in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] and safely crash-landed on Corellia. The pilot contacted Solari by radio to request evacuation. The Rebel officer quickly assembled a group of operatives in the [[Tyrena cantina]] and dispatched them to rescue the pilot in the wilderness. However, the first to find the crash site were a group of [[The Flail|Flail]] thugs,<ref name="SWG:E" /> looking for ship parts to salvage.<ref name="P14.1">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=734|text=Update Notes: Publish 14.1 - March 24, 2005}}</ref> The criminals assassinated the Rebel pilot on the spot. The Flails then attacked the rescue team but they were all killed in the fight. The Rebel operatives later reported to Solari. The officer was deeply outraged that a hero of the Alliance who had survived an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] attack could then be murdered without reason by common criminals. In retaliation, Acun Solari initiated a vendetta against criminals and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] in the Corellian system, convinced that it was the duty of the Alliance to fight them. The Rebel operatives therefore struck a Flail camp near Tyrena and killed 15 of them. They also eliminated a band of [[Binayre Pirates]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. Eventually, Rebel pilots destroyed a group of [[Hidden Daggers]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] in Corellian space.<ref name="SWG:E" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateRebelOfficerQuestGiver.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Acun Solari]]
Acun Solari was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:E" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Acun Solari was added to the game with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Update Notes: March 24, 2005|Publish 14.1]], on [[March 24]], [[2005]].<ref name="P14.1" />

Since Acun Solari spawned under the generic "rebel_officer_questgiver" template, his appearance was randomized under one of six possible depictions and would fluctuate after each server reset.<ref name="SWG:E" />
